rows.text: In the Canvas Age, almost everyone could consume Wishpower, and Wishing Nickels were the most accessible medium. Whatever was written on them had a probability of coming true as long as one was pious enough. Initially, people pinned their hopes for a better life on the nickels: Romance, promotions, or just having a good day... But after spending too many years in the Eternal Canvas, the wishes people made grew increasingly distorted, such as sending their neighbors spiraling into the sky or paving the roads with banana peels. The Worlds Reborn Initiative did not salvage these Wishing Nickels, which was why some residents preferred to remain in the painting, continuing their game of mutual wish-making.
